recipes.name: Vegan Black Bean Quesadillas
ingredients_raw: 1 (15 ounce) can great Northern beans, drained and rinsed
1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
0.5 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed

steps.text: Blend great Northern beans, 3/4 cup tomatoes, and garlic in a food processor until smooth. Add nutritional yeast, cumin, chili powder, salt, and cayenne pepper and blend until combined.
Transfer bean mixture to a large bowl. Stir in black beans and remaining 1/4 cup tomatoes.

Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Place a tortilla in hot oil. Spread about 1/4 cup filling over tortilla. Place another tortilla on top of filling; cook until filling is warmed, about 10 minutes.
Spray the top tortilla with cooking spray and flip quesadilla to cook the second side until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling.

raw_recipe.headline: Vegan Black Bean Quesadillas
raw_recipe.description: These vegan black bean quesadillas replace the cheese with puréed great Northern beans, nutritional yeast, and spices for a Mexican-inspired meal.

video.description: These quesadillas are flavorful, crispy, and are capable of much variety! Add salsa or guacamole to your liking and serve alongside rice or with chips! Jalapeno and hot sauce adds that extra spice if you like these spicy! Tasty and filling meal that anyone can enjoy!

review.reviewBody:
Like others I had a whole lot of skepticism about a quesadilla without cheese, but with wife on a vegan kick I thought I'd give it a try. It was delicious and cheap! The texture wasn't quite the same as with cheese, but it wasn't unappealing or weird like some vegan recipes. I think the nutritional yeast really gives it a earthy yet cheese like flavor, infinitely better than "Vegan Cheese"

Anyway, added a diced Jalapeno with the black beans, also added 1-1 1/4 cup clack beans instead of 1/2 cup. I should of added the whole can though, wouldn't of hurt anything.

Will surely make this again!

Changes for future: one can diced tomatoes, use 3/4 of the can. Cook over low-medium heat (“3”) to achieve the cooking times listed (10/3 minutes). Use 1/2-3/4 cup filling per 8” tortilla. Add yeast as needed. I just mashed the northern bean mixture. Replaced cayenne with red pepper flakes. A little bland. Serve with guacamole.

Morning Star Farms spicy black bean burgers make a great addition to vegan quesadillas. I just heat them in the microwave and crumble them. 
In this recipe they could be used instead of the beans or as a substitute for just some of them.

Wow! So good! I'm on a vegan diet for a bit and found this recipe and I am impressed! I was a bit worried because of the one bad review but I needn't be! 
I made this and it turned out great! I burned my first quesadilla but the filling was so good that I was still able to enjoy the burnt one! 
I switched to way less oil and cooking coconut oil for my other tortillas. 
Other modifications:
I used 10" tortillas and because of that I put half a cup of filling instead of the 1/4th cup. That was a good amount. More was too much. 
I also, added more black beans to the recipe. About 1/4th cup more.
I made 3 quesadillas with the 10" tortillas but I could have made 4 if I had rationed the filling properly.

Yum! I used a whole can of black beans and tomatoes, and cooked the quesadillas on med-low with a thin coat of spray oil to get them nice and crispy. We dipped them in vegan sour cream and they were soooo good. I had some filling left after making enough for dinner, so I saved it, and it was even better the next day. This is the first time I've made anything vegan(on purpose), and first time using nutritional yeast and vegan mayo. I was pleasantly surprised, and will make them again for sure.

Delicious! I followed another reviewer and added the whole can of black beans. I put some Dayia pepper jack shreds (fake cheese I bought at Sprouts that melted very nicely) right on top of a whole grain tortilla in the pan first, then added the spread and another tortilla on top. Definitely a recipe I am keeping and using again! Thank you!

These were really yummy! I had sour cream and salsa on hand but I would love to try these with guacamole. Are used one whole tomato I cut all the pulp and seeds and set that aside and chopped up the firmer part of the tomato and threw it in the food processor the rest I added to the filling as I mixed in the black beans and it was good

These were a huge hit with the whole family, and I'm about to make them again right now. I used black beans in place of the Great Northern because that's what I had on hand. My family (aside from myself) eats cheese, but no one asked for it or missed it. These are a new fam fave!

These were a big hit for both Vegans, Glutten intolerant and even the regular folk.
I added, one finely chopped Jalepeno, and about a cup of fresh corn.
Also some shredded Soya chedder and Soya mozzerella.
Just a little as the nutritional yeast has enough of a cheesy flavour.

I am a non-vegan who is cooking for visiting Vegan family members. The Quesadillas were a huge hit for both Vegan and non-Vegan diners. The only change I made to the recipe is that I used my pancake griddle to cook them so that I could produce two at a time.
Excellent!

Chris

Our daughter is home from NC because of the Flo Hurricane & I made these for her but added grilled organic shred chicken & organic shred cheese for the rest of the family & it was a HIT!! Will definitely make again!! Great with the fresh organic avocado on the side for dipping ;-)
These were delicious for the Daniel Fast. Best thing I have eaten so far. Thank you.
Very tasty and easy to make.

I think it is delicious! No I did nto make any changes. I was surprised when I read the recipe ingredients and saw it called for 1 can of Great Northern Beans but I followed it and I think it is very good.

These are absolutely delicious! I have recently had to modify my diet because I am nursing my new baby and he has a cow’s milk protein intolerance. I was sad to miss out on cheese, but with this recipe you don’t even miss it. So yummy!!!

Does not live up to the hype of all the reviews... the flavor is not very tasty and it was way too think to blend so I added a little water, but then it was too thin. The flavor was so bland so I just ended up adding regular cheese anyway. I even used way more nutritional yeast than the recipe called for
Awesome
I had to add a little bit of corn starch to thicken it up as the tomatoes made it a little too runny.
Awesome!!
Awesome!!
